Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Asigurări
About the job 
 We are EAZY ASIGURAR I - a cloud-first insurance technology company building and operating a modern, fully cloud-native platform on AWS. We invest heavily in our cloud platform because we believe that reliable, well-architected infrastructure is the foundation of great software products.
 We're growing our platform team and looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys building things, automates anything they have to do twice, and wants to work where cloud infrastructure meets AI. You'll work on systems that run live insurance products, and you'll help us build the AI-assisted tooling that will change how our engineering team works.
 What you'll be doing 
 Running and improving our AWS setup. Mostly ECS and EKS, plus the networking, IAM and security around them.
 Building CI/CD with GitHub Actions. You'll make builds faster, deployments safer and pipelines easier to understand.
 Keeping production visible. You'll build Grafana dashboards, write alerts that only fire when something actually needs a person, and help debug issues when something goes wrong.
 Building agentic workflows and AI integrations. You'll connect LLMs like Claude to our tools and pipelines, build automations that do real work, and help make them safe and reliable.
 Using AI in your own work. We use Claude and other AI assistants as part of the job, not as a side experiment. You'll learn to use them well, and we'll want to hear your ideas.
 Improving developer experience. That means local environments, reusable workflows, and documentation people actually read.
 Building with security in mind. We work in a regulated industry, so secrets handling, least-privilege access and audit trails are part of the job from the start.
 What we're looking for 
 1–3 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud or infrastructure. Strong side projects or an internship count too.
 Solid basics in AWS. You know your way around the console and the CLI.
Working knowledge of Docker , and at least a basic understanding of Kubernetes.
 Comfortable with Git and pull-request workflows. Experience with GitHub Actions is a plus.
 Scripting skills in Bash, Python or TypeScript. You don't need to be an expert, just able to get things done.
 Real curiosity about AI and LLMs. If you've built a small agent, used an LLM API, or automated something with Claude or a similar tool, we'd love to hear about it.
A problem-solving mindset: you dig into issues, write down what you find, and ask for help when you're stuck.
Good communication in English. 
 Nice to have 
 • Experience with EKS, or with GitOps tools like ArgoCD
 • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar)
 • Observability tools: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, CloudWatch
 • Experience with MCP servers, agent frameworks or prompt engineering
 • Some exposure to security tooling (SAST, dependency scanning, secrets management)
 What's in it for you 
 Real ownership. Your work goes to production, not into a drawer.
 A front-row seat to AI in engineering. Few teams use agentic workflows in day-to-day infrastructure work. We do.
 Mentorship that speeds up your growth. You'll get regular pairing, honest feedback, and a clear path from junior to mid to senior.
 A modern stack and little legacy. We modernize continuously, and you'll help decide what comes next.
 A small team where your work is seen. 
 Sounds like a good fit? Don't hesitate to apply. We'd love to hear from you!
